#![allow(unsafe_code)]
use crate::render_lock::{render_allocation_count, render_locked};
unsafe fn web_boundary() {}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn miso_engine_web_v1_render(handle: u32) -> u32 {
    render_locked(|| handle)
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn miso_engine_web_v1_source_seek(handle: u32) -> u32 {
    render_locked(|| {
        let next = handle + 1;
        next
    })
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn miso_engine_web_v1_spectrum_select(handle: u32) -> u32 {
    render_locked(move || handle)
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn miso_engine_web_v1_dispose(handle: u32) -> u32 {
    handle
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn miso_engine_web_v1_render_allocation_count() -> u32 {
    render_allocation_count()
}
